name: Eight charge sites along x with local compensating reference at x=0
field: Uniform quasistatic E_x; periodic cells placed along y
sourceDerivation: Sites carry Q_i=q_c*n_i at x_i=pitch*position_i. Their compensating charge is at x=0. D_x=sum_i x_i Q_i and H_probe=-E_x D_x.
assumptions: Canonical rotor numbers are assigned physical charge q_c; this is an implementation assumption.
Neglect screening and image-charge changes to the lever arms; Hamiltonian is the supplied effective rotor model.
The charge return is local to each cell and its x-directed dipole contribution vanishes.
No phase-drive transition operator is substituted for the physical charge dipole.
authority: Chosen effective probe geometry and illustrative units, not a derived material or admitted electromagnetic realization.
